findings.title: The translation cache key doesn't include the site default locale this fallback depends on
findings.body: The fallback chain now depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which is set per site. But the process-wide LRU cache in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:71-76` keys entries only on `key`, `config.locale` and `backend.object_id`. In a multisite process, take a key missing in `de`. A `de` user on site A (default `fr`) caches the French string, and a `de` user on site B (default `es`) is then served that French string. No error tells anyone. The same stale value also shows up on a single site after an admin changes `default_locale`, until the entry is evicted. Fix: add the default locale (or the joined `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` chain) to the cache key `k`.

findings.title: Fallback locales are only preloaded in web requests
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` only runs in `set_locale`. `I18n.translate` (`lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:68`) loads just `config.locale`. So code outside a controller (Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks) that switches to a non-default locale gets no site-default or `en` fallback until a request in that process has loaded those locales. It sees `translation missing` text instead, and the per-locale cache keeps it. Consider loading the whole fallback chain inside `translate`, e.g. `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale].each { |l| ensure_loaded!(l) }`.

contracts.action: Every I18n.t now goes through the Fallbacks backend, which asks FallbackLocaleList#[] for the chain [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en]
contracts.equivalent_path: The old `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` (production/profile only), which fell back to I18n.default_locale
contracts.before_after: Before: fallbacks to the default locale, in production only. After: fallbacks in every environment, to the per-site default locale and then en.
contracts.visible_effect: A missing key in the user's locale shows the site-default or English text. The result is cached under a key that ignores the site default locale.
contracts.failure_mode: In multisite, or after default_locale changes, the cached fallback text from another site or the old setting is served without any sign of it.

contracts.action: set_locale preloads every locale in the fallback chain
contracts.before_after: Before: only the request locale was loaded. After: the request locale, the site default and en are loaded under LOAD_MUTEX.
contracts.visible_effect: Fallback strings are available within web requests.
contracts.failure_mode: Code that doesn't pass through set_locale (jobs, mailers) gets no preload, so the fallback can come back as missing.

summary: The PR replaces the production-only `config.i18n.fallbacks` with a custom fallback chain (user locale → site default locale → en) in every environment, and preloads those locales in `set_locale`. Main issue: the translation LRU cache key leaves out the per-site default locale, so in multisite (or after the setting changes) the cache can serve fallback text from the wrong locale.
